prompt:
Generate the comprehensive single-page portfolio for Ahsan: Student Developer & Creative Learner (Siswa SMK Kelas 11 PPLG).

Structure and exact content to include:

1. HERO / HOME (id="home"):
- Name badge: "🌱 Siswa SMK Kelas 11 PPLG • Student Developer"
- Main Title: "Ahsan"
- Subtitle: "Student Developer & Creative Learner"
- Description: "Siswa PPLG yang sedang belajar membangun sesuatu melalui code, design, dan kreativitas."
- Profile Visual: An avatar placeholder with stylish terminal/code avatar or geometric initial "A", subtle glowing neon cyan border (#06b6d4), terminal badge `status: learning_in_progress`.
- CTA Buttons: "Lihat Portfolio" (anchor to #projects, neon cyan filled/glow) and "Tentang Saya" (anchor to #about, subtle border button).
- Quick highlight pills: Python, C++, Web, Android Studio, Creative Writing & Drawing.

2. ABOUT ME (id="about"):
- Headline: "Tentang Saya"
- Narrative: Ahsan adalah siswa SMK kelas 11 program keahlian Pengembangan Perangkat Lunak dan Gim (PPLG) yang sedang mengeksplorasi dunia software development dan kreativitas digital.
- Emphasize: Portofolio ini merupakan dokumentasi perjalanan belajar, eksperimen, dan proyek yang sedang dikembangkan secara jujur apa adanya sebagai pelajar.
- Student Highlights: 
  * "Belajar Mandiri & Sekolah": Mengembangkan logika algoritma di kelas dan mengeksplorasi tools kreatif di waktu luang.
  * "Prinsip Pembelajaran": Berfokus pada pemahaman fundamental, pemecahan masalah bertahap, dan konsistensi mencoba hal baru.

3. CURRENT FOCUS (id="focus"):
Highlight 6 things currently being learned with clean interactive cards and progress badges:
1) Memperkuat fundamental programming (algoritma & struktur data dasar)
2) Membuat project yang lebih nyata (aplikasi fungsional sederhana)
3) Mengembangkan portfolio (mendokumentasikan proses & karya)
4) Mempelajari AI dan Python (otomatisasi dan pengenalan konsep AI)
5) Meningkatkan kemampuan web development (tata letak responsif & interaktivitas)
6) Membangun pengalaman untuk persiapan PKL (kesiapan adaptasi dan kolaborasi)

4. SKILLS (id="skills"):
Grouped with honest student proficiency levels (Beginner / Learning / Developing / Familiar — NO "expert"):
- Programming: Python (Learning), C++ (Beginner)
- Web: HTML (Developing), CSS (Developing), JavaScript (Learning)
- Mobile: Android Studio (Beginner)
- Tools: Git (Learning), GitHub (Learning), VS Code (Developing)
- Multimedia: Adobe Animate (Beginner)
- Creative: Drawing (Familiar), Story Writing (Familiar)
Interactive filter or categorized card grid with subtle cyan badges and level indicators.

5. PROJECTS (id="projects"):
Interactive filterable card grid using clean structured cards. Include modal or expandable drawer details and clear tags:
1) "Nusantara Travel" | Kategori: Web Development | Status: Completed (Latihan Web)
   - Deskripsi: Website sederhana bertema perjalanan Indonesia yang dibuat dalam pembelajaran Pemrograman Web menggunakan HTML dan CSS. Fitur & konsep yang dipelajari: target="_blank", colspan, form dengan pilihan metode pembayaran.
   - Tech: HTML, CSS
2) "Hello Toast" | Kategori: Mobile App | Status: Completed (Latihan Android)
   - Deskripsi: Proyek Android Studio untuk mempelajari dasar pengembangan aplikasi Android. Memiliki fitur tombol Count dan Toast serta tampilan sederhana dengan angka penghitung di tengah layar.
   - Tech: Android Studio, Java/Kotlin, XML
3) "Git & GitHub Branch Project" | Kategori: Version Control / Tools | Status: Ongoing Practice
   - Deskripsi: Mempelajari penggunaan repository, branch, commit, push, dan pengelolaan versi proyek. Salah satu pola pengembangan yang digunakan adalah memisahkan versi asli dan versi modifikasi menggunakan branch.
   - Tech: Git, GitHub, Terminal
4) "Python Problem Solving" | Kategori: Programming & Logic | Status: Active Learning
   - Deskripsi: Sedang mengembangkan kemampuan Python, terutama penggunaan list, dictionary, looping, dan penyelesaian masalah algoritmik sederhana.
   - Tech: Python 3, CLI
5) "Adobe Animate / Multimedia Experiment" | Kategori: Multimedia & Animasi | Status: Exploration
   - Deskripsi: Sedang mempelajari Adobe Animate dan tertarik mengembangkan kemampuan dalam animasi serta visual digital 2D.
   - Tech: Adobe Animate, Vector Art
6) "Di Ambang Longsor" | Kategori: Creative Writing | Status: Draft Cerpen
   - Deskripsi: Memiliki minat dalam menggambar dan menulis cerita. Salah satu karya cerpen yang pernah dikembangkan adalah narasi fiksi "Di Ambang Longsor".
   - Tech: Creative Writing, Storytelling

6. LEARNING JOURNEY (id="journey"):
Vertical timeline showing Ahsan's authentic learning roadmap:
- 01. Mulai mengenal programming: Menemukan ketertarikan pada logika komputer dan teknologi saat masuk SMK jurusan PPLG.
- 02. Belajar Python dan C++: Memahami konsep variabel, tipe data, percabangan, dan perulangan.
- 03. Mengenal web development: Membuat struktur halaman dengan HTML dan mempercantik tampilan dengan CSS.
- 04. Mengerjakan project Android: Mencoba Android Studio untuk pertama kalinya dan membuat aplikasi interaktif Hello Toast.
- 05. Belajar Git dan GitHub: Memahami pentingnya version control dan eksplorasi kerja branch secara terstruktur.
- 06. Mengeksplorasi AI dan multimedia: Menjelajahi konsep dasar Python untuk AI serta eksplorasi Adobe Animate.
- 07. Mengembangkan creative work: Menggabungkan daya imajinasi lewat gambar digital/tradisional dan penulisan cerita.

7. CREATIVE CORNER (id="creative"):
A personal experimental showcase section showing Ahsan's non-coding passions:
- Drawing: Sketsa digital dan gambar tradisional, eksplorasi proporsi dan pencahayaan.
- Story Writing: Menulis naskah fiksi dan cerpen termasuk "Di Ambang Longsor", mengeksplorasi emosi dan alur cerita.
- Game Modding: Eksplorasi modifikasi asset dan logika game untuk mempelajari cara kerja game engine dari dalam.
- Animation: Eksperimen timeline dan keyframing menggunakan Adobe Animate.

8. CONTACT (id="contact"):
Simple, honest student contact section:
- GitHub: Placeholder profile link (`github.com/username-placeholder`)
- Email: Placeholder email link (`ahsan.student@example.com`)
- LinkedIn: Placeholder link (`linkedin.com/in/ahsan-student-placeholder`)
- Note: "Terbuka untuk diskusi santai mengenai programming, sharing pengalaman belajar, atau saran pengembangan skill."

Styling:
- Dark mode: deep slate/navy `#090d16` and `#111827`, card backgrounds `#151d30`, borders subtle `#22304d`
- Accents: Neon cyan `#06b6d4` and emerald `#10b981`
- Modern cards with rounded-2xl, subtle glassmorphism backdrop-blur, elegant hover effects.
- Clean vanilla JS for tabs/filters and smooth scroll interactions.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

The design system is crafted specifically for a high-potential vocational software engineering student (SMK PPLG), positioning the developer as technically proficient, curious, and product-minded. It merges an engineering-first mental model with an approachable student showcase aesthetic. 

The design combines **Technical Dark Mode Minimalism** with **Subtle Glassmorphism**:
- Deep obsidian and charcoal backdrops evoke modern developer IDEs and terminal workflows.
- Vibrant cyan and emerald accents emulate active syntax highlighting, compiler success states, and live telemetry.
- Subtle frosted glass panels with delicate hairline borders provide structured depth without overwhelming content readability.
- The overall emotional response is precision, intellectual ambition, polished craft, and forward momentum.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a 12-column responsive fluid grid pinned to an optimal max-width of `1200px`:

- **Desktop (>= 1024px):** 12 columns, `1.5rem` (24px) gutters, and `2rem` (32px) screen margins. Side-by-side terminal demos and dual-column project cards.
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px):** 8 columns, `1.25rem` (20px) gutters, and `1.5rem` (24px) margins. Grids collapse into 2-column or stacked formations.
- **Mobile (< 768px):** 4 columns, `1rem` (16px) gutters, and `1rem` (16px) margins. Strict vertical single-column stack with scrollable horizontal badge rows when needed.

Element gap rhythms follow an 8-point system, maintaining tight visual binding between headings and associated code representations.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses frosted glass layers and localized optical light spill instead of heavy drop shadows:

- **Base Layer (Level 0):** Pure dark background (`#0b0f19`) accented by faint, large-radius atmospheric radial gradient glows (e.g., `#06b6d4` at 6% opacity) placed strategically behind key sections.
- **Card Surface (Level 1):** Background `rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.75)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`. Outlined by a crisp `1px` translucent border `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`.
- **Hovered / Interactive Surface (Level 2):** Background tint brightens to `rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`. Border transitions to `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)`, accompanied by a diffuse ambient cyan aura: `0 8px 30px -4px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)`.
- **Floating Modals & Code Drawers (Level 3):** Background `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`, bordered by `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)` with shadow `0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Call to Action):** Solid vibrant cyan (`#06b6d4`) background, text `#0b0f19` in semi-bold `Plus Jakarta Sans`. Subtle neon box-shadow (`0 0 20px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.35)`). Hover scales to emerald accent (`#10b981`) or shifts brightness with smooth transitions.
- **Secondary (Code / Demo Links):** Translucent obsidian glass background (`rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.8)`), white text, `1px` border `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`. On hover: cyan border and cyan text.
- **Ghost / Icon (GitHub, LinkedIn):** No background, text `#9ca3af`. On hover: background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`, text `#06b6d4`.

### Skill Level Badges (Pill Chips)
Rendered in `JetBrains Mono` uppercase with an optional pulsating status dot:
- **Learning:** Tint `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)`, text `#22d3ee`, border `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4)`. Shows active exploration.
- **Developing:** Tint `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)`, text `#34d399`, border `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4)`. Shows applied competence.
- **Familiar:** Tint `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)`, text `#fbbf24`, border `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35)`. Shows working familiarity.
- **Beginner:** Tint `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12)`, text `#cbd5e1`, border `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)`. Shows introductory baseline.

### Project Showcase Cards
- Container styled with `rounded-2xl`, glassmorphic slate background (`rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.7)`), and hairline border `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`.
- Features an integrated mock-terminal header: 3 macOS-style dots (red, yellow, green in subtle muted tones) and a title in `JetBrains Mono`.
- Code tag chips array at the bottom using monospaced labels (`Next.js`, `Laravel`, `TailwindCSS`).

### Input Fields & Contact Form
- Background: `rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.6)`.
- Border: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`.
- Focus state: `border-color: #06b6d4`, subtle cyan inner ring `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2)`.
- Placeholder text: `#4b5563`.

### Interactive Code Snippets / Terminal Window
- Distinct dark background (`#080c14`) nested inside cards.
- Integrated copy button floating in the top right that flashes `#10b981` (Emerald) with a "Copied!" checkmark when clicked.

## Brand & Style

The design system is crafted specifically for a high-potential vocational software engineering student (SMK PPLG), positioning the developer as technically proficient, curious, and product-minded. It merges an engineering-first mental model with an approachable student showcase aesthetic.

  - Secondary (`#10b981` / Vibrant Emerald): Production status indicators, deployed project tags, and learning progression badges.
  - Tertiary (`#38bdf8` / Sky Cyan): Interactive hovers, code identifiers, and metadata tags.
- **Text & Hierarchy:**
  - Text Primary: `#f9fafb` (98% contrast against `#0b0f19`)
  - Text Secondary: `#9ca3af` (Readable muted tone for metadata and timestamps)
  - Text Tertiary: `#6b7280` (Discreet inline code labels, line numbers, and micro-copy)
- **Status Badges (Level Indicators):**

1. **Headlines (`Plus Jakarta Sans`):** Warm, geometric, and welcoming. Gives large titles human energy and structural balance without appearing overly mechanical.
2. **Body Text (`Inter`):** Neutral, exceptionally clear, and optimized for high-density reading across screens.
3. **Labels & Snippets (`JetBrains Mono`):** Carries the genuine developer signature across skill badges, terminal windows, code metrics, and Git commit logs.

Always apply tabular numerals (`tnum`) for metrics, project counters, and timeline dates.

## Shapes

The design uses smooth modern radii to counterbalance the dark, technical nature of the theme:

- **Large Project & Showcase Cards:** `rounded-2xl` (1rem / 16px) creates a polished, frame-like feel for application screenshots and terminal windows.
- **Input Fields & Small Containers:** `rounded-xl` (0.75rem / 12px) ensures comfortable target touch areas.
